mapper.select: select count(*) from blog_user where deleted_at = 0
select count(*) from blog_comment where deleted_at = 0 and review = 0
select count(*) from blog_message where deleted_at = 0 and review = 0
select count(*) from blog_comment where deleted_at = 0 and review = 0 and date(create_time) = #{date}

select date(create_time) as date, count(*) as count from blog_comment where deleted_at = 0 and review = 0 and date(create_time) >= #{startDate} and date(create_time) <= #{endDate} group by date(create_time) order by date(create_time)

select up.avatar, up.nickname, c.content, c.target_type, case when c.target_type = 1 then ifnull(a.article_title, '') when c.target_type = 3 then ifnull(left(t.content, 20), '') else '' end as target_name, c.create_time as created_at from blog_comment c left join blog_user_profile up on c.user_id = up.user_id and up.deleted_at = 0 left join blog_article a on c.target_type = 1 and c.target_id = a.id and a.deleted_at = 0 left join blog_talk t on c.target_type = 3 and c.target_id = t.id and t.deleted_at = 0 where c.deleted_at = 0 and c.review = 0 order by c.create_time desc limit #{limit}
select count(*) from blog_comment where deleted_at = 0 and review = 1
select count(*) from blog_message where deleted_at = 0 and review = 1
select count(*) from blog_category where deleted_at = 0
select count(*) from blog_tag where deleted_at = 0
select count(*) from blog_friend_link where deleted_at = 0
